name: Angerfang Encampment
summary: Dragonmaw orcs gather at Angerfang Encampment in the central Wetlands, threatening nearby dwarven settlements. Chieftain Nek'rosh Skullcrusher leads the renegades as they prepare to strike Menethil Harbor.

sections.title: A Bastion in the Bogs
sections.body: Dragonmaw warriors hold the marsh around Angerfang Encampment in the central Wetlands. Barricades and watchtowers guard the camp, where warriors, bonewarders, and dark spellcasters loyal to the old ways gather. From these defenses, the clan raids travelers on the roads and menaces nearby dwarven digs, including Whelgar's Excavation Site.

sections.title: Nek'rosh's Ambition
sections.body: Chieftain Nek'rosh Skullcrusher leads the Dragonmaw from Angerfang. He is the son of Nekros, the warlock who enslaved the red dragonflight at Grim Batol. Nek'rosh hates the Alliance and has gathered catapults and raised war banners for an assault on Menethil Harbor. Alliance commanders in the port city send champions into the camp to seize the banners, break the war machines, and kill Nek'rosh before his attack can set the harbor ablaze.

faq.answer: Chieftain Nek'rosh Skullcrusher rules the Dragonmaw at Angerfang. He is the son of the notorious Dragonmaw warlock Nekros Skullcrusher, and directs regional raiding parties while planning to conquer Menethil Harbor.

faq.q: Are the orcs here allied with Thrall's Horde?
aliases: is angerfang part of thralls horde
faq.answer: No. The Dragonmaw here remain independent of Thrall's New Horde and cling to the dark heritage of the Old Horde. They are hostile to Alliance and Horde travelers alike, and Thrall's warriors consider them feral outcasts and hunt them for armor crafting materials.

faq.q: Why is the Alliance focused on destroying this camp?
faq.answer: Captain Stoutfist and Menethil Harbor's dwarven defenders learned that Nek'rosh had gathered catapults and a large force at Angerfang to bombard and conquer the harbor. The Alliance attacks first to break the siege before it begins.

faq.q: Why do warlocks seek out this encampment?
faq.answer: Dragonmaw dark spellcasters at Angerfang carry Rods of Channeling, dark ritual tools sought by practitioners of the demonic arts who need to complete the Tome of the Cabal.

angles.text: For Menethil Harbor's defenders, Angerfang threatens the coast. Bringing down Nek'rosh's war banners and taking his head is vital to securing the coastal trade routes.
As a warlock, you may seek the Rods of Channeling carried by the camp's dark shadowwarders. These artifacts are needed for the bindings written within the Tome of the Cabal.
